definitions.explanation: Describes something or someone that is morally upright, socially acceptable, and following the right path. Often used to describe a way of living or earning a livelihood.

examples.japanese: {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な⟦{生|い}き{方|かた}→生き方：10014_ikikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He is living an honest life.

examples.japanese: {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{稼|かせ}いだ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}いたい→養う：04478_yashinau⟧。
examples.english: I want to support my family with money earned through honest work.

notes:
USAGE:
{真|まっ}っ{当|とう} describes something that is morally sound, legitimate, or respectable. It is commonly used when contrasting honest behavior with dishonest or shady alternatives.

FORMS:
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な + noun (a proper ~)
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb (properly, honestly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (a proper/legitimate job)
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧ (a respectable life)
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧ (to live honestly)
- {真|まっ}っ{当|とう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧ (to earn a living honestly)
